messages:
ops_lead: Quick heads-up — we need a scheduled maintenance for the regional KV prefetch layer next Wed 03:00-04:30 UTC. This is a targeted rollout where customers can opt in to a short, controlled traffic shift to dedicated serving to avoid degraded reads.

incident-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: maintenance id mnt-2026-03-kv-prefetch. ETA 2026-03-25 03:00 UTC. Affected: subset of read-heavy customers (opt-in).

devops_amy: Summary: small schema tweak + rolling cache warm to reduce cold-start spikes. No full pod restarts expected if opt-in used. Non-opted customers will see brief higher tail latency and possible 502 retries for <60s during a compaction step.

oncall_jordan: Oncall plan: I’ll be primary during the window, Amy you’re secondary. Ops runbook in #eng-oncall updated with rollback toggles.

support_lead: Support note: we should send an opt-in invite to impacted customers and include an easy toggle. Draft below — please review.

pm_ralf: Also want a short statuspage update so customers see it as an opt-in scheduled maintenance, not an outage. Keep wording clear on expected impact if they don't opt-in.

security_sam: Confirming no data-plane schema changes. Security review done. No additional auth impact.

ops_lead: Draft statuspage (please copy/paste and edit):
```
Headline: Scheduled maintenance — targeted KV prefetch warm (opt-in)
Start: 2026-03-25 03:00 UTC
End: 2026-03-25 04:30 UTC
Impact: Customers who opt in will be shifted to dedicated read routing for a brief prefetch/compaction period; expected latency improvement. Customers who do NOT opt in may experience short tail-latency spikes and transient 502s for up to 60s during compaction.
Mitigation: opt-in available via console toggle or support request; live rollback will be available.
```

support_lead: Draft customer email (short):
```
Subject: Action needed — optional maintenance to reduce cold-start latency (Mar 25)
Hi <Customer>,
We’re running an optional maintenance to warm KV caches for your region on Mar 25 03:00–04:30 UTC. Opting in will temporarily route reads to dedicated capacity during the work and minimize tail latency.
To opt in: go to Console > Regions > Prefetch Opt-in OR reply to this email and we’ll flip it for you.
If you don’t opt in, you may see short latency spikes or rare 502s for <1m.
Thanks — Redwood Inference Operations
```

devops_amy: Operational toggle examples:
```bash
# enable opt-in for tenant
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  https://control.redwood.ai/api/v1/tenants/TE-1234/optins/prefetch -d '{"enabled": true}'

# rollback (disable)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  https://control.redwood.ai/api/v1/tenants/TE-1234/optins/prefetch -d '{"enabled": false}'
```

oncall_jordan: Runbook checklist (short):
- prewindow: verify canary tenant opt-ins set and healthy
- T-10m: set alert thresholds for latency + 502 spike detection
- during: monitor kv-metrics, route fallback test every 5m
- rollback: disable opt-in per-tenant and trigger cache rebuild if needed

ops_lead: Customer segmentation: I’ll publish a list of ~15 high-read tenants to the thread tomorrow. We will contact them individually and offer a 30m pre-check to verify compatible clients.

support_lead: Can we include a quick FAQ in the email? e.g., why opt-in, timeline, how to rollback, who to contact (support + oncall).

pm_ralf: Statuspage update cadence: publish scheduled maintenance now (notice), update to "in progress" at start, and publish completion with metrics summary (tail latency percentiles) at end.

incident-bot: Reminder: add incident tags: maintenance, opt-in, kv-prefetch. Pager alert channel: #eng-oncall.

security_sam: Quick checklist for customers requiring compliance: we will record actions in audit logs and provide KMS-wrapped key references on request.

devops_amy: One more ops note — for a couple tenants with legacy TLS ciphers, the dedicated routing path will fall back; we’ll list those in the pre-check.

oncall_jordan: Acknowledged. I’ll create the real-time dashboard (latency/502/route-fallback) and post the link here T-2h.

ops_lead: Thanks all. Action items: Amy — add curl toggles to runbook; Jordan — dashboard + oncall steps; Support — finalize email + FAQ; Ralf — schedule statuspage updates. I’ll draft customer list and start outreach tomorrow. :thumbsup:

support_lead: ack :white_check_mark:

devops_amy: ack, will add to runbook and run a local dry-run on Monday.

pm_ralf: ack, prepping statuspage entries and templates.

security_sam: ack, will attach audit instructions.

ops_lead: Closing thread for now — post any changes here.
